# Claude Code 2.1.300 hook payload fixtures

Real hook stdin JSON captured from Claude Code 2.1.300 in an isolated two-session
smoke (proj-a, proj-b; SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, SessionEnd).

Paths are anonymized: the operator home directory was replaced with `/home/USER` in `cwd` and
`transcript_path`. The payloads are otherwise verbatim. Original and anonymized
sha256 hashes are recorded in the lane HANDOFF.
